title: Prism V4.2 Models Configuration Schema
description:
Validates ~/.claude/skills/prism/config/models.json and ~/.prism/models.local.json.

Merge semantics (HC-08):
- 'models' object: same model_id key -> deep merge; different key -> append
- 'pools' object: same pool name -> user array REPLACES base array (not merged); different name -> append

Unlike providers, this schema does NOT require config_version (models.json is data-only and safer to evolve).

models.description: Map of model alias (unique in this skill) -> model config. Alias is what appears in pools and in panel.ps1 requests.

pools.description: Named model pools. standard_pool / deep_pool / backup_pool are reserved names used by Flow B.

standard_pool.description: Models eligible for Standard tier. Router picks 2 from here (HC-13).

deep_pool.description: Models eligible for Deep tier. Deep flow picks 3.

backup_pool.description: Fallback models used when primary provider fails after retries.

model_id.description: Exact model identifier sent in the API request (e.g. 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'deepseek-v4-pro').

model_type.description: Standard: fast, low-latency chat. Reasoning: heavier chain-of-thought models (require max_tokens >= 16000 auto-floor).

overrides.description: Model-level parameter overrides. Highest precedence over provider.request_defaults.

disabled_by_default.description: If true, this model is skipped in pool selection unless explicitly requested. Used for known-flaky models (e.g. gpt-5.5 fake SSE).

note.description: Free-form annotation, e.g. why the model is disabled or preferred.
